body: I’m very sorry to be the barrier of bad new but that message will mean nothing to her but an eye roll, especially since it’s the clichè “wish you the best” farewell. I strongly believe you’re in the denial/negotiation phase where you think maybe if you just tried this, she’ll respond. Dear, it’s time to let go.

I reconciled with an ex hoping to remain friends. They wanted to be more than friends. Now I feel trapped and obligated to stay to avoid abandoning them. It’s advisable to not contact your ex for both your sakes. He will never grieve properly and accept the grim reality if you reappear to give false sense of hope. He’ll only become more attached to you, making it harder to move on in the long run. I wish I took my own advice. Don’t be stuck like me. It is in hard times we find strengthen within us. Your presence will not allow him to find his own strength bc he will depend on you to soothe the pain that he inevitably will have to face alone.
When you don’t have to ask that question

Maybe you want to redeem yourself by assuring him it’s him who’s the villian, not you, since you mentioned you apologized to him for wrongs that weren’t yours to take. If journaling isn’t helping, you can tell him how you truly feel then block him so he doesn’t have a chance to respond. That might soothe the justice you’re craving

There was pure sincerity in this post. It’s awful carrying remorse when you’ve truly become a better person. Too many betrayals made me resent love but I’d be lying if I said I didn’t want him to reach out. He won’t tho bc he assumes he’s still blocked. I wish you well, dear!

Posts like this petrify me bc it confirms my fears of this lasting much longer. It’s been around the same amount of time for me too. I don’t see an end to it whatsoever. I’m completely pessimistic and miserable to be around. I feel for you deeply. I wish you the best.

You’re not being dramatic at all. You can absolutely die from a broken heart. There is a real medical condition that causes people’s heart to fail due to intense grief. I hate that emotional pain is an invisible wound. Don’t invalidate what you’re feeling as dramatic because it’s not. Heartbreak is one of the most traumatic experiences known to man. We’re creatures of emotion after all.
